global_style_prompt: Premium 2D motion graphics animation with subtle layered 2.5D interface depth, high-end B2B SaaS product film style. Dark warm espresso-brown Consultry stage, deep brown-black, never grey. Cream-colored product cards with hair-thin coral top borders, one signature warm coral provenance line, stone-grey outlines and secondary UI fragments. Precise mechanical cubic easing, clean snap-to-grid assembly, generous negative space, restrained enterprise design, smooth 60fps feel. The camera is mostly locked with only sub-perceptible pushes. No readable text anywhere: every text area must be an abstract blurred bar or simple geometric placeholder. Exact logo and typography will be composited later.
global_negative_prompt: No readable text, no fake words, no misspelled UI, no neon glow, no lens flare, no particle explosion, no flashy sci-fi holograms, no 3D extrusion, no playful bounce, no generic blue SaaS gradient, no random stock footage, no talking heads, no photorealistic office people unless explicitly requested as a dark abstract viewport texture, no overcomplicated camera moves, no high-saturation purple wash.

style_lock.purpose: Use this as the invariant style fingerprint for every generated scene so the clips cut together as one film.
style_lock.prompt_suffix: STYLE CONTINUITY LOCK: keep the same dark warm espresso stage, same cream card material, same stone-grey outlines, same single coral provenance line, same soft vignette, same 2D orthographic camera language, same restrained premium B2B SaaS motion. Maintain a quiet top-center logo-safe area. Keep all generated text as blurred bars only. End the scene with the main objects settled and still for at least the final 0.35 seconds so the editor has a clean cut point.

geometry.logo_safe_area: top center, roughly y=110-190 depending on composited logo scale

camera.allowed_motion: subtle push or lateral drift up to 2% only
camera.forbidden: handheld, parallax flythrough, whip-pan, zoom burst, rotation

motion.movement_limit: one primary moving system and one secondary accent at a time
motion.snap_language: clean mechanical docking, no elastic bounce

post_overlay_policy.generated_video: background plates, cards, lines, placeholders only
post_overlay_policy.post_composite: exact Consultry SVG, German headlines, real UI labels, numbers, CTA
post_overlay_policy.reason: prevents AI text/logo drift and makes style consistent across regenerated scenes

stitching_contract.edit_rule: Prefer straight cuts on held frames. Use 8-frame match dissolves only when the coral line continues across the boundary. Use 12-frame dark dissolves only around the minimal positioning reset.
stitching_contract.global_tail_handle: Each scene prompt asks for a final 0.35s hold. If a generated clip has residual motion at the tail, trim 8-18 frames earlier or regenerate.
stitching_contract.global_head_handle: The first 0.20s of each clip should be visually compatible with the previous scene's end state. If it jumps to a new color, camera, or material, regenerate with stronger style_lock.

regenerate_scene_if: background is grey, blue, purple, or visibly different from the warm espresso master stage
generated clip contains readable text, fake German words, or a fake Consultry wordmark
camera performs a large zoom, pan, rotation, handheld move, or 3D flythrough
coral provenance line changes color, thickness, or becomes neon/glowing
cream cards become bright white, glassy, playful, or rounded beyond the Consultry product style
final 0.35s of the clip still contains major motion and cannot be cut cleanly
scene starts with a style reset that ignores the prior scene's end state
the top-center logo-safe area is blocked by generated objects during post-overlay moments
accept_scene_if: first and last frames share the same palette, vignette, material, and camera grammar as the master references
scene contains only placeholders where text/logo/real UI will be composited
main motion lands early enough for a stable tail hold
cut_map continuity is visible in the final frame and next opening frame
scene can be trimmed by 8-18 frames without losing the VO beat
quality_gate.post_generation_check: Create first/last-frame contact sheets for every generated scene before stitching. Compare against refs/contact-sheets/master-reference-sheet.jpg and reject drift before compositing text.

voiceover_recommended_68s.script:
Ihre Kunden erwarten mehr. Schneller. Präziser. Fundierter.

Das Wissen dafür existiert längst. In Excel, Verträgen, Projekten, Köpfen und Tools. Alles verteilt.

Consultry bringt es zusammen. Ihr Geschäft. Ihre Marke. Ihr Wissen. Ihre Projekte.

Signal erkennt Ausschreibungen, Markttrends und Opportunities. Team sieht Projekte, Auslastung und Faktura-Risiken.

Ihr Vertrieb fragt Consultry. Aus Ihrem Beratungswissen entsteht ein Angebot. Passend zum Kunden. Passend zur Situation.

Im Kundentermin ist Ihr Wissen da, wenn es zählt. Die richtige Antwort in Sekunden. Risiken bleiben sichtbar.

Consultry ist kein AI-Chatbot. Es ist das Betriebssystem für Beratungsarbeit. Agentisch. Gesteuert. In Ihrem Kontext.

Der Business Case ist klar: Ein gesparter Beratertag zahlt Consultry. Der Rest ist Marge.

Weniger Tools. Mehr Effizienz. Mehr Beratung.

Jetzt auf die Warteliste.
voiceover_recommended_68s.direction: German, calm executive B2B SaaS tone, confident, precise, not overexcited. Short pauses after short sentences. Consultry pronounced naturally like an English product name. AI-Chatbot pronounced clearly and modern. Target 66-68 seconds.

alternate_existing_voiceover_mode.edit: Keep M01-M09 unchanged and extend M10 hold from 4.0s to 6.9s.
